module: Simplified access to the first TerrainBlock of the scene: terrain height and normal at a point. A modder uses it to place objects on the ground or orient an element along the slope. The block found is cached by its id.
usage:
local z = core_terrain.getTerrainHeight(vec3(x, y, 0))
local n = core_terrain.getTerrainNormal(vec3(x, y, 0))
notes: All functions return nil if there is no TerrainBlock in the scene.
Only the first TerrainBlock found is used.

getTerrain.desc: Returns the TerrainBlock object (cached by id, otherwise the first result of scenetree.findClassObjects("TerrainBlock")).

getTerrainHeight.desc: Returns the terrain height at the given point (terrain:getHeight).

point.desc: World position; only x and y matter (inferred from code).

getTerrainNormal.desc: Returns the terrain normal at the point (terrain:getNormal(point, true, true)).

getTerrainSmoothNormal.desc: Returns the smoothed terrain normal at the point (terrain:getSmoothNormal(point, true, true)).
